name: Empirical estimates

subjectOf.text: Open source software accounts for somewhere between 78 percent and 98 percent of all core digital infrastructure software, according to industry estimates.
subjectOf.abstract: According to some estimates, open source software accounts for between 78%14 and 98%15 of all core digital infrastructure software.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Decentralization – Why We Need Technology Infrastructure Upgrades (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3808859
scope_conditions: based on 2015 and 2017 industry survey estimates

subjectOf.text: Losses from smart contract vulnerabilities are large and growing, with 2021 losses alone estimated at 680 million dollars and cumulative global losses estimated at over 6 billion dollars.
subjectOf.abstract: In 2021 alone total financial loss from smart contract bugs was estimated at $680 million
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Code Review DAO (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4734750

subjectOf.text: The total effective stock of human-generated text is estimated at roughly 300 trillion tokens, with a plausible range from 100 trillion to 1 quadrillion tokens.
subjectOf.abstract: Researchers estimate that the total effective stock of human-generated text may currently stand at approximately 300 trillion tokens, with the range varying from 100 trillion to 1 quadrillion tokens.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Artificial Intelligence The Final Frontier (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5095633
scope_conditions: estimate of effective stock, not raw internet volume

description: 3 claims in the published works of Wulf A. Kaal carry the concept tag 'empirical-estimates'. Derived node: a roster, not an adjudicated definition.
